lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\DokuWiki\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
1 use of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

places: lib/Controller/PageController.php:125 OCP\AppFramework\Http\EmptyContentSecurityPolicy::addAllowedChildSrcDomain(): deprecated since Nextcloud 15, Nextcloud 33 is the last major to have it; use addAllowedWorkerSrcDomains or addAllowedFrameDomain
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated and that Nextcloud 36 no longer has: the app fails on the first major without it, once it declares that one.

Nothing in the app calls 2 routes outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 20 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).

lines: 3 uses in 3 files of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 26 to 28. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.

1 inline style in templates/. The default Content Security Policy of the server allows inline style; a response whose policy disallows it drops them. A stylesheet added with OCP\Util::addStyle() holds in both cases.
